lastCompletedStory.title: Real-writer regression test: phase:shipping survives the terminal teardown

nextStoryContext: Both PRD stories (US-001, US-002) now pass. This closes out CAM-191 / ADR 0013: the auto-ship dispatch is anchored in runSidecarLoop (post-clearActive) so phase:shipping survives the terminal teardown chain, and a real-writer regression test (test/supervisor/auto-ship-real-writers.test.ts) locks the fix in with the ACTUAL production writers (makeClearActive, makeSetPhaseFn, and the newly-extracted makeOnProgress factory from src/supervisor/host.ts), not fakes. The RED->GREEN verification was done manually this story (git checkout origin/main -- src/supervisor/loop.ts, observed the test fail with 'idle' instead of 'shipping', restored the branch's loop.ts, observed it pass) and the transcript is recorded in the US-002 commit message body rather than as an automated CI step -- there is no lingering red-state artifact to clean up. The only surgical addition beyond the test itself was exporting makeOnProgress(stateFilePath, stateFileBase) from host.ts (previously an inline closure inside buildSupervisorOptions); buildSupervisorOptions now just calls it, so this is a zero-behavior-change refactor covered by all pre-existing host.ts/loop.ts tests plus the new one. No further work is queued in this PRD; the next implementer should check for a fresh prd.json (a new PRD cycle) rather than continuing this one.
